a2a.name: Orchestrator
a2a.description: Multi-model workflow execution engine. Sibling agent-native apps in the same workspace can dispatch tasks to it over A2A and read activity back by tag.

tagConvention.note: Pass an opaque `tags` map on brain-send / workflowRun / workspaceCreate, then reassemble activity with runsList / spawnList / workspaceList using `tagMatch` (v3-DESIGN §16).
